patch_description: The champion's weakest metrics are noise_reduction (0.37), slope_changes (20.4), false_reversals (17.6) and smoothness (0.50), while correlation (0.89) and lag (0.37) are strong — so there is headroom to denoise harder without hurting tracking. Changes: (1) the per-scale decision in AtrousDenoiseStage now fully hard-kills noise-dominated scales (no residual detail pass) and the hard zone is widened to mag<0.65 so more fine scales die; (2) the wavelet stage is run twice (two-pass cascade) — the second pass re-estimates each scale on already-denoised data, killing surviving transitional detail, which is what keeps residual variance (and thus noise_reduction) high; (3) TrendFusion is slightly strengthened (fusion 0.45) and the predictive-poly lead is kept; (4) DirectionalHysteresis is strengthened (k=0.8, blend=0.7) plus a final 5-tap median snap so sub-noise slope churn that drives false reversals is flattened; (5) all smoothing is zero-phase (a trous, bidirectional Kalman, symmetric median/SG with edge lead), so lag and correlation are preserved. Signal-bearing scales still pass untouched, so tracking accuracy is unaffected. Same I/O contract: len(y) == len(x) - W + 1.
